Character design of Rubeus Hagrid (book version):
A lovable half-giant chibi gamekeeper of Hogwarts, about 1.5x the height of Harry and much broader with huge shoulders, big hands, and boots, retaining cute chibi proportions with a large head. Wild tangled long black hair and a bushy black beard hiding most of his lower face, small kind beetle-black eyes crinkling with warmth, rosy cheeks.
